property_summary: After any call to fallback with exactly 10 ether and a strictly increasing block timestamp, the contract's balance must be zero if and only if block.number is a multiple of 15 (i.e., block.number % 15 == 0); the bug changes the condition to block.number % 15 == 1, so the balance rule is violated whenever block.number % 15 equals either 0 or 1.
change_summary: Replace the block.number modulus remainder check from 0 to 1.
